candidates.description: This vector represents a sequence of consecutive integers corresponding to calendar dates or numerical values.
This vector represents multilingual text processing, specifically handling Hindi script characters alongside English abbreviations and technical terms.
This feature vector represents subword tokens and fragments of Hindi text script.
This feature vector activates strongly on the Devanagari character 'ध' (dha) and its corresponding vowel-consonant conjuncts.
This vector activates for Hindi verb roots ending in the "n" sound, representing ongoing or infinitive actions.
This feature vector represents common Hindi language suffixes, prefixes, and character fragments.
This vector represents non-English script tokens, particularly Devanagari vowel signs and characters, alongside miscellaneous foreign and alphanumeric artifacts.
This vector is related to the Sanskrit Brahmi script, specifically the letter "ṣa" (ष) and its various vowel and conjunct variations.
This vector is related to Hindi and Devanagari script characters and sub-word tokens.
This vector activates for the word "Spotify" and various characters, subwords, and conjuncts from the Hindi writing system.
